answer: A farm of 56 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in crystal, queued in spiral, and dune publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 26 identities per epoch. A farm of 4969 identities would post 669 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
